description: Research r22 (dev only, step-capped, B200 workers): r21 mal0_st500_ent01_t10 (r16 + entropy bonus 0.01 on steps after one whose logged entropy was below 0.1) at lr 2e-6 instead of 1e-6. In r1-r3, lr 2e-6 peaked earliest and highest and then collapsed, and every r16-r20 slide began near entropy 0.04; r21's first seeds held entropy at 0.10 with no slide and were still rising at step 500 (0.395-0.400). This tests whether the entropy floor makes the faster lr safe within the 500-step budget.
